badge: Platform admin · never expires · cannot be deleted
breadcrumb: Platform admin · highest privilege, every action is audited
title: Platform overview
confirmPasskey: Verify with a passkey to continue
setupCode: Enter the setup code from operations
recoveryCodes: Save these 10 recovery codes; they are shown only once

settings.confirmBody: The change applies immediately and is audited.

users.title: Workspaces
users.hint: Manage: extend / end trial · revoke sessions · delete (optional archive) · ban

reason.label: Reason
reason.required: Required, recorded in the audit log

trial.title: Change the trial end
trial.impactEnds: The new time is in the past: the trial ends now and archiving starts in {min} min
trial.impactSlot: Keeps using 1 active workspace slot while extended (now {used} / {limit})
trial.impactWrites: The workspace keeps consuming the daily D1 write budget while extended
trial.impactSessions: All of the user's sessions are revoked; they must sign in again

end.title: End trial
end.body: The workspace becomes EXPIRED now; archiving and the download e-mail follow in {min} min, then the account is deleted.

revoke.title: Revoke all sessions
revoke.body: The user must sign in again on every device.

ban.title: Ban e-mail
ban.body: The e-mail can no longer sign up or sign in.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.archive: Archive first and e-mail the download link
delete.bodyArchive: The data is packed as a ZIP and the link is e-mailed, then the account and business data are deleted.
delete.bodyNoArchive: No archive: business data and account are deleted now, no e-mail, no recovery. A reason is required.

archives.title: B2 archive ZIPs
archives.hint: Download links are valid for 15 minutes, created on click
archives.deleteBody: The ZIP is deleted now and the e-mailed download link stops working.

blocked.title: Disposable e-mail blocklist
blocked.body: One domain per line; e-mails of these domains cannot sign up.

audit.title: Admin audit log
audit.chainBroken: Hash chain check failed: the log may have been tampered with

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.body: Keep at least 2 passkeys; adding and deleting require passkey verification.
